chapters.label: How he defends
chapters.text: Pepe was the man of the match in the Euro 2016 final, when Portugal beat France. This is how he defends crosses. The winger crosses... and Pepe heads it away!

chapters.label: Touching distance
chapters.text: Watch again. He stays close to the striker, at touching distance, always between him and the goal.

chapters.label: Up first
chapters.text: He stays on his feet, jumps first, and meets the ball with his forehead. High and wide!

chapters.label: Head it away
chapters.text: Like Pepe: stay close to your striker, stay on your feet, and head every cross away.
